name.value: Valemount Pines Golf Course & RV Park

description.value: A private campground and golf course 3 km outside Valemount, with grassy tent sites beside Swift Creek and the McLennan River under mountain views; flush bathrooms and filtered drinking water are included, tent sites from $34/night plus taxes.

raw_osm.name: Valemount Pines Golf Course & RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground and golf course in Valemount, BC with tent sites, half-service, and full-service RV sites. Phone 250-566-2500 and email [email protected] appear consistently across all pages. Potable water is confirmed via 'filtered drinking water from our own water filtering & treatment plant.' Showers confirmed via 'Toilet & Shower' amenity listings and 'We provide hot water for showers.' Laundry listed as an amenity on full service sites. Camp store sells ice, snacks, and supplies. Online reservation forms are present. Town of Valemount with full amenities is 3 km away per the FAQ. No address is provided in OSM or clearly on the website.
